title: Cost, Concurrency, and Model Selection Strategy
description: Speed equals points; concurrency limits are hidden killers; use expensive models early and cheaper models later
detail:
1. Under staged progression and ranking decay, speed directly determines points: the score loss from saving model costs is far greater than the money saved
2. API concurrency limits (429) are hidden killers: running 3 targets in parallel may already cause failures — measure each provider's concurrency limits before starting; sweep's --minutes-per rotation naturally limits how many auto runs are active at once
3. Adjust dynamically: use strong models early to gain speed (about 52 CNY per proof artifact), then switch to cheaper models later to increase concurrency; returns diminish at the margin (the most expensive cases reached 284 CNY per proof artifact)
4. Immediate result locking + dynamic scoring: prioritize easy targets first for coverage; early mistakes (misconfiguration/low concurrency) are the most costly
Source: TCH/CHYing retrospectives
